The patient's cardiopulmonary and abdominal exams are unremarkable. Laboratory values are ordered as seen below.

Cl-: 100 mEq/L
K+: 3.3 mEq/L

This condition leads to excessive aldosterone production, causing sodium retention and potassium loss, which aligns with the patient's lab findings of hypokalemia and hypochloremia. \boxed{Primary Aldosteronism}
